brief: A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.

requirements.requirement: Three bases meeting at a corner
requirements.evidence: Full hex bases at (0,0,0), (1,0,0) and (1,-1,0) share one corner junction. Joint bolts at (1,-1) slot 4 and (1,0) slot 3 lock them together, clearing the LOOSE_BODY warning.

requirements.requirement: Raised platform on a spike at that corner
requirements.evidence: A mount spike (spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0) stands at the three-base junction, and a large platform (platform-lrg) was set on it via setSpikeAccessory. A solid spike refused a platform, so the spike was re-added as mount type. The platform is not a separate node in get_build, so its presence rests on the accepted op.

finish.summary: The stand has three full hex bases at (0,0), (1,0) and (1,-1) meeting at one corner, with a mount spike at that junction carrying a large platform. Two joint bolts lock the bases. check_build reports no errors, no LOOSE_BODY warnings, and meshClash is clear. Only an info note about possible caps on open faces remains; I did not add caps since the brief did not ask for them.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
